unusual_experiment.name: CROSS_DB_NESTED_BEGIN_AFTER_GRAPH_COMMIT
unusual_experiment.baseline: Outer UnifiedDB BEGIN IMMEDIATE; derived ClayGraph commit; UnifiedDB ACK inside existing outer transaction; outer commit.
unusual_experiment.baseline_result: PASS: graph commit and UnifiedDB APPLIED acknowledgement completed.
unusual_experiment.treatment: Outer UnifiedDB BEGIN IMMEDIATE; derived ClayGraph commit; then legacy-style second BEGIN IMMEDIATE on the same UnifiedDB connection.
unusual_experiment.treatment_result: REFUTED_DIRECT_COMPOSITION: sqlite3.OperationalError cannot start a transaction within a transaction; after outer rollback the derived graph commit remained durable while outbox acknowledgement remained PENDING.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: The direct composition is not executable as written. The surviving graph commit plus PENDING advisory outbox state remains compatible with idempotent replay, but this is not atomic cross-database rollback evidence.
